title: Data Access Helper functions for fetching data from multiple PostGreSQL databases
text: R package config based data fetching PostgreSQL databases R. package intended facilitate config based execution set SQL queries set PostGreSQL database backends. general wrokflow : configure database connections JSON files register SQL files (one query per file) config file matches connection run get_datasets(get_config(), queries) queries list names registered queries. primary use case ease database access Quarto documents. can list database queries yaml header, makes easy identify data used Quarto document. get_datasets() function handles connection setup pooling, fetching data, connection pool cleanup. returns list datsets, name dataset corresponds configured query name.

code: library(OeDataAccess)  queries <- c("query1","query2")  #config takes a qry_cfg and db_cfg file, but defaults to # `config/queries.json` and `config/db_config.json` config <- get_config()  datasets <- get_datasets(config, queries)  head(datasets$query1) library(OeDataAcces)  setup_config()
